entries.title: Psalms 103:1
segments:
PSALM CIII. 
 
  The psalmist stirs up himself to praise God for all his benefits,   ver. 1-19.   Calls upon all his works to assist him therein, ver. 20-22.   A psalm of David.

entries.title: Psalms 103:5
segments: V. 5. The eagles-Which lives long in great strength and vigour.

entries.title: Psalms 103:11
segments: V. 11. So great-So much above their deserts and expectations.

entries.title: Psalms 103:14
segments: V. 14. Knoweth-The weakness and mortality of our natures, and the frailty of our condition, so that if he should let loose his hand upon us, we should be irrecoverably destroyed.

entries.title: Psalms 103:21
segments: V. 21. His hosts-A title often given to the angels, in regard of their vast numbers, mighty power, unanimous concurrence, and exquisite order. Ministers-This Hebrew word is commonly used of the highest and most honourable sort of servants,
